text: {"translations": {"fr": "Qui veut de la miel doit supporter la piqûre de l'abeille, ma chérie. Si tu désires quelque chose de beau, il faut avoir un peu de patience, même si ça pique en chemin.", "es": "Quien quiere la miel debe aguantar la picadura de la abeja, mi vida. Si quieres algo bueno, ten paciencia, aunque por el camino a veces pique.", "it": "Chi vuole il miele deve sopportare il pungiglione dell'ape, tesoro mio. Se desideri qualcosa di bello, abbi un po' di pazienza, anche se lungo la strada a volte punge.", "en": "If you want the honey, you have to bear the bee's sting, my dear. If you want something good, be patient — even if it stings a little along the way."}, "feeling": ["care", "blessing"], "cultural_notes": [{"expression": "lli bgha l3sel ysber l9ris n7el", "literal": "whoever wants honey, let him be patient with the bee's sting", "meaning": "If you want something valuable, you must accept the hardship that comes with it."}], "confidence": "high"}

translations.fr: Qui veut de la miel doit supporter la piqûre de l'abeille, ma chérie. Si tu désires quelque chose de beau, il faut avoir un peu de patience, même si ça pique en chemin.
translations.es: Quien quiere la miel debe aguantar la picadura de la abeja, mi vida. Si quieres algo bueno, ten paciencia, aunque por el camino a veces pique.
translations.it: Chi vuole il miele deve sopportare il pungiglione dell'ape, tesoro mio. Se desideri qualcosa di bello, abbi un po' di pazienza, anche se lungo la strada a volte punge.
translations.en: If you want the honey, you have to bear the bee's sting, my dear. If you want something good, be patient — even if it stings a little along the way.

cultural_notes.expression: lli bgha l3sel ysber l9ris n7el
cultural_notes.literal: whoever wants honey, let him be patient with the bee's sting
cultural_notes.meaning: If you want something valuable, you must accept the hardship that comes with it.

text: {"translations": {"fr": "Tu es devenue aussi haute qu'un palmier dattier, mais tu ne sais toujours pas cuisiner !", "es": "Te has hecho alta como una palmera datilera, ¡pero todavía no sabes cocinar!", "it": "Sei cresciuta alta come una palma da datteri, ma ancora non sai cucinare!", "en": "You've grown tall as a date palm, but you still don't know how to cook!"}, "feeling": ["humor", "love", "pride"], "cultural_notes": [{"expression": "twil b7al nkhla", "literal": "tall like a date palm", "meaning": "a warm Moroccan way of saying a grandchild has grown up big and tall"}], "confidence": "high"}

translations.fr: Tu es devenue aussi haute qu'un palmier dattier, mais tu ne sais toujours pas cuisiner !
translations.es: Te has hecho alta como una palmera datilera, ¡pero todavía no sabes cocinar!
translations.it: Sei cresciuta alta come una palma da datteri, ma ancora non sai cucinare!
translations.en: You've grown tall as a date palm, but you still don't know how to cook!

cultural_notes.meaning: a warm Moroccan way of saying a grandchild has grown up big and tall
